```{r}
library(vroom)
library(tidyverse)
library(forecast)
library(patchwork)
library(lmtest)

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

data <- vroom("C:/Users/aidan/Downloads/CompanyGrowth.csv") %>%
  mutate(Qrtr = factor(Qrtr))

data_historical <- data %>% filter(Year <= 2024)

predictors <- c("Income", "Production", "Savings", "Unemployment")
```

```{r}
forecast_growth <- function(train, test) {
  X <- test
  for (v in predictors) {
    f <- as.formula(paste(v, "~ Year + Qrtr"))
    X[[v]] <- predict(lm(f, data = train), newdata = test)
  }
  growth_fit <- lm(PctGrowth ~ Income + Production + Savings + Unemployment,
                   data = train)
  predict(growth_fit, newdata = X)
}

rmse <- function(actual, pred) sqrt(mean((actual - pred)^2))

holdout_results <- function(cut_year) {
  tr <- data_historical %>% filter(Year < cut_year)
  te <- data_historical %>% filter(Year >= cut_year)

  known_fit <- lm(PctGrowth ~ Income + Production + Savings + Unemployment,
                  data = tr)

  tibble(
    holdout         = paste0(cut_year, "-2024"),
    n_quarters      = nrow(te),
    rmse_model      = rmse(te$PctGrowth, forecast_growth(tr, te)),
    rmse_if_X_known = rmse(te$PctGrowth, predict(known_fit, newdata = te)),
    rmse_mean_only  = rmse(te$PctGrowth, mean(tr$PctGrowth))
  )
}

bind_rows(holdout_results(2024), holdout_results(2020)) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("rmse"), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

```{r}
current_model <- lm(PctGrowth ~ Income + Production + Savings + Unemployment,
                    data = data_historical)
summary(current_model)
```

```{r}
data_historical <- data_historical %>%
  mutate(fitted_vals = fitted(current_model),
         resids = residuals(current_model),
         time = Year + (as.numeric(as.character(Qrtr)) - 1) / 4)

title_theme <- theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))

p_acf <- forecast::ggAcf(data_historical$resids) +
  labs(title = "ACF of MLR Residuals") + title_theme

p_res <- ggplot(data_historical, aes(x = fitted_vals, y = resids)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted", x = "Fitted Values", y = "Residuals") +
  title_theme

p_hist <- ggplot(data_historical, aes(x = resids)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "darkgray", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Histogram", x = "Residuals", y = "Count") + title_theme

p_qq <- ggplot(data_historical, aes(sample = resids)) +
  stat_qq() + stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Normal QQ Plot", x = "Theoretical", y = "Sample") + title_theme

p_time <- ggplot(data_historical, aes(x = time, y = resids)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Residuals Over Time", x = "Year", y = "Residuals") + title_theme

(p_acf | p_res | p_hist) / (p_qq | p_time)

print(shapiro.test(data_historical$resids))
print(bptest(current_model))
print(dwtest(current_model))
print(Box.test(data_historical$resids, lag = 8, type = "Ljung-Box"))
```

```{r}
lm_income     <- lm(Income ~ Year + Qrtr,       data = data_historical)
lm_production <- lm(Production ~ Year + Qrtr,   data = data_historical)
lm_savings    <- lm(Savings ~ Year + Qrtr,      data = data_historical)
lm_unemp      <- lm(Unemployment ~ Year + Qrtr, data = data_historical)

future_time <- data.frame(Year = rep(2025, 4), Qrtr = factor(1:4))

data_2025 <- data.frame(
  Year = 2025,
  Qrtr = factor(1:4),
  Income       = predict(lm_income, newdata = future_time),
  Production   = predict(lm_production, newdata = future_time),
  Savings      = predict(lm_savings, newdata = future_time),
  Unemployment = predict(lm_unemp, newdata = future_time)
)

predictions_2025 <- predict(current_model, newdata = data_2025,
                            interval = "prediction")

data_2025 <- data_2025 %>%
  mutate(Predicted_PctGrowth = predictions_2025[, "fit"],
         Lower_PI_old = predictions_2025[, "lwr"],
         Upper_PI_old = predictions_2025[, "upr"])

# Simulation interval that includes uncertainty in the forecasted predictors
pred_models <- list(Income = lm_income, Production = lm_production,
                    Savings = lm_savings, Unemployment = lm_unemp)
pred_resids <- sapply(pred_models, residuals)
beta <- coef(current_model)
growth_resids <- residuals(current_model)

set.seed(469)
B <- 5000

sim_summary <- map_dfr(1:4, function(q) {
  idx <- sample(nrow(pred_resids), B, replace = TRUE)
  base <- unlist(data_2025[q, predictors])
  Xq <- sweep(pred_resids[idx, predictors], 2, base, "+")
  sims <- as.vector(cbind(1, Xq) %*% beta) +
    sample(growth_resids, B, replace = TRUE)
  tibble(Qrtr = q,
         Lower_PI_sim = quantile(sims, 0.025),
         Upper_PI_sim = quantile(sims, 0.975))
}) %>% mutate(Qrtr = factor(Qrtr))

data_2025 <- left_join(data_2025, sim_summary, by = "Qrtr")
print(data_2025 %>%
        select(Year, Qrtr, Predicted_PctGrowth, starts_with("Lower"),
               starts_with("Upper")))
```

```{r}
library(forecast)
library(tidyverse)

# ---- 0. Keep only data through 2024 (2025 is what we're forecasting) ----
data_hist <- data %>% filter(Year <= 2024)

# ---- 1. Holdout split: train through 2023, test on 2024 ----
train <- data_hist %>% filter(Year < 2024)
test  <- data_hist %>% filter(Year == 2024)

# ---- 2. Turn training growth into a quarterly time series ----
y_train <- ts(train$PctGrowth,
              start = c(train$Year[1], train$Qrtr[1]),
              frequency = 4)

# ---- 3. Look at the series: plot, ACF, PACF ----
ggtsdisplay(y_train)

# ---- 4. Fit the SARIMA on the training data ----
fit_sarima <- auto.arima(y_train, seasonal = TRUE)
summary(fit_sarima)

# ---- 5. Check the residuals (want white noise) ----
checkresiduals(fit_sarima)

# ---- 6. Holdout accuracy: forecast 2024, compare to actual ----
fc_test <- forecast(fit_sarima, h = nrow(test), level = 95)
rmse_sarima <- sqrt(mean((test$PctGrowth - fc_test$mean)^2))
rmse_sarima

actual_test <- ts(test$PctGrowth,
                  start = c(test$Year[1], test$Qrtr[1]),
                  frequency = 4)
autoplot(fc_test) +
  autolayer(actual_test, series = "Actual") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(2015, 2025))   # zoomed in so the forecast is visible

# ---- 7. 2025 projections: refit on ALL data through 2024 ----
y_all <- ts(data_hist$PctGrowth,
            start = c(data_hist$Year[1], data_hist$Qrtr[1]),
            frequency = 4)
fit_all <- auto.arima(y_all, seasonal = TRUE)
summary(fit_all)

fc_2025 <- forecast(fit_all, h = 4, level = 95)

sarima_2025 <- data.frame(
  Year = 2025,
  Qrtr = 1:4,
  Model = "SARIMA",
  Predicted = as.numeric(fc_2025$mean),
  Lower_95 = as.numeric(fc_2025$lower),
  Upper_95 = as.numeric(fc_2025$upper)
)
sarima_2025
```

checkresiduals(fit_all)

rmse_mean <- sqrt(mean((test$PctGrowth - mean(train$PctGrowth))^2))
rmse_mean

```{r}

# Uses data_hist, train, and test from your SARIMA script (all filtered to Year <= 2024)

# ---- 1. Prophet needs a date column `ds` and a value column `y` ----
# Each quarter becomes the first day of that quarter (Q1 -> Jan 1, Q2 -> Apr 1, ...)
add_prophet_cols <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(ds = as.Date(paste(Year, (Qrtr - 1) * 3 + 1, 1, sep = "-")),
                y  = PctGrowth)
}
train_p <- add_prophet_cols(train)
test_p  <- add_prophet_cols(test)
all_p   <- add_prophet_cols(data_hist)

# ---- 2. Fit on the training data ----
set.seed(469)
m_test <- prophet(train_p,
                  weekly.seasonality = FALSE,   # no weekly pattern in quarterly data
                  daily.seasonality  = FALSE,
                  yearly.seasonality = 2,       # a few terms is plenty for 4 points/year
                  interval.width     = 0.95)    # match the SARIMA 95% intervals

# ---- 3. Look at the fit and the pieces Prophet found ----
fit_in <- predict(m_test)                       # in-sample fit
plot(m_test, fit_in)
prophet_plot_components(m_test, fit_in)         # trend + yearly seasonality

# ---- 4. Residual check on the training data ----
prophet_resids <- train_p$y - fit_in$yhat
forecast::ggAcf(prophet_resids) + labs(title = "Prophet residuals ACF")
shapiro.test(prophet_resids)

# ---- 5. Holdout accuracy: forecast 2024, compare to actual ----
fc_test_p <- predict(m_test, test_p %>% select(ds))
rmse_prophet <- sqrt(mean((test$PctGrowth - fc_test_p$yhat)^2))
rmse_prophet

# ---- 6. 2025 projections: refit on ALL data through 2024 ----
set.seed(469)
m_all <- prophet(all_p,
                 weekly.seasonality = FALSE,
                 daily.seasonality  = FALSE,
                 yearly.seasonality = 2,
                 interval.width     = 0.95)

future_2025 <- data.frame(ds = as.Date(c("2025-01-01", "2025-04-01",
                                         "2025-07-01", "2025-10-01")))
fc_2025_p <- predict(m_all, future_2025)

prophet_2025 <- data.frame(
  Year = 2025,
  Qrtr = 1:4,
  Model = "Prophet",
  Predicted = fc_2025_p$yhat,
  Lower_95 = fc_2025_p$yhat_lower,
  Upper_95 = fc_2025_p$yhat_upper
)
prophet_2025
```
